title: Controlled Input
prompt:
Build a controlled text input. **Requirements:** 1. Import `useState` and `ChangeEvent` from `react`. 2. Export a function component named `Greeting`. 3. Inside the component: - Hold the input value in `useState('')`. - The `onChange` handler must accept `ChangeEvent` and call `setName(e.target.value)`. 4. Render: - An `` whose `value` is bound to state and `onChange` to the handler. - A `

` showing `Hello, {name}!` when `name` is non-empty, otherwise `Hello, stranger!`.
hints: `ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>` is what `<input onChange>` receives -- the value lives at `e.target.value`.
A controlled input is one where React owns the value: bind `value` AND `onChange` together.
Use a ternary to switch the greeting; don't store the rendered text in state.

Greeting.tsx.name: input
Greeting.tsx.description: Render a controlled input bound to value + onChange
